name: agents-md-master
description: Create, audit, refactor, maintain, and evaluate evidence-based AGENTS.md instruction systems for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Design and audit evidence-based Codex instruction systems.
interface.longDescription: AGENTS.md Master helps experienced operators create, audit, refactor, maintain, and evaluate Codex instruction hierarchies. It maps effective scope and authority, finds semantic duplication and contradictions, routes policy to the correct enforcement layer, and prepares approval-gated change proposals backed by repository evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $agents-md-master in audit mode; load only the needed reference and do not edit.
Use $agents-md-master in semantic-governance mode; load only the needed reference.
Use $agents-md-master in topology mode to design a scoped AGENTS.md system.
Use $agents-md-master in evaluate mode to compare this proposal with a baseline.
